Extended civil restraint orders in force

A list of people who have been issued with orders stopping them from bringing certain cases to court.

From:
HM Courts & Tribunals Service
Published:
20 September 2022
Last updated:
28 August 2026 — See all updates

Applies to England and Wales

Documents

List of extended civil restraint orders

HTML

Details

If a judge orders an extended civil restraint order, the order is limited to a specified group of courts.

They last 3 years, but can be renewed for a further 3 years.

They’re usually given when a person’s application for a court hearing is refused but they won’t accept the judge’s decision.
